packet.headline_seed: French man on trial accused of raping partner after contact with Dominique Pelicot

Pelicot, one of the worst sex offenders in modern French history , is serving 20 years in prison after he was found guilty of drugging his then wife and inviting dozens of men to rape her in their home in the south of France over almost a decade. He and 50 other men were found guilty after the biggest rape trial in French history in 2024. Continue reading...

Man accused of sedating and filming abuse of partner had contact with Pelicot, who was jailed for drugging wife and inviting men to rape her A bodyguard from Lyon is to go on trial for allegedly sedating and raping his partner after he was in contact online with Dominique Pelicot, who was convicted of drugging and raping his own wife, Gisèle Pelicot. Pelicot, one of the worst sex offenders in modern French history, is serving 20 years in prison after he was found guilty of drugging his then wife and inviting dozens of men to rape her in their home in the south of France over almost a decade. He and 50 other men were found guilty after the biggest rape trial in French history in 2024.

The man, who was arrested in 2023, is accused of sedating his longterm partner, raping her and filming her. His lawyer, Gabriel Versini-Bullara, said he denied the charges. The investigation had established that the bodyguard had contact with Pelicot but this did not mean he had been a “disciple” of Pelicot, Versini-Bullara said. The court will seek to determine how close the contact was and whether the man had sought Pelicot’s advice on how to sedate and abuse his wife. The investigating magistrates’ summary of the case, seen by Agence France-Presse, alleges the bodyguard had sought to benefit from Pelicot’s “experience” in drugging and raping his wife. The fact that the woman was deeply sedated “ruled out all form of consent”, they wrote.

The 73-year-old, who made contact with men in an online chatroom called “Against her knowledge”, crushed sleeping tablets and anti-anxiety medication into his then wife’s food and drink to render her unconscious. Gisèle Pelicot won support worldwide after insisting that the rape trial be held in public to raise awareness of the use of drugs and sedation to rape women, saying: “It’s not for us to have shame, it’s for them”. The man going on trial on Thursday worked as an international bodyguard for high-profile clients at film festivals and on trips around the world, including the US and the Gulf states. Investigators found communications between him and Pelicot as part of their initial investigations into Pelicot in 2020.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: The Guardian World]
Man accused of sedating and filming abuse of partner had contact with Pelicot, who was jailed for drugging wife and inviting men to rape her

A bodyguard from Lyon is to go on trial for allegedly sedating and raping his partner after he was in contact online with Dominique Pelicot, who was convicted of drugging and raping his own wife, Gisèle Pelicot.

Pelicot, one of the worst sex offenders in modern French history, is serving 20 years in prison after he was found guilty of drugging his then wife and inviting dozens of men to rape her in their home in the south of France over almost a decade. He and 50 other men were found guilty after the biggest rape trial in French history in 2024.

The 73-year-old, who made contact with men in an online chatroom called “Against her knowledge”, crushed sleeping tablets and anti-anxiety medication into his then wife’s food and drink to render her unconscious.

Gisèle Pelicot won support worldwide after insisting that the rape trial be held in public to raise awareness of the use of drugs and sedation to rape women, saying: “It’s not for us to have shame, it’s for them”.

The man going on trial on Thursday worked as an international bodyguard for high-profile clients at film festivals and on trips around the world, including the US and the Gulf states.

Investigators found communications between him and Pelicot as part of their initial investigations into Pelicot in 2020.

The man, who was arrested in 2023, is accused of sedating his longterm partner, raping her and filming her. His lawyer, Gabriel Versini-Bullara, said he denied the charges. The investigation had established that the bodyguard had contact with Pelicot but this did not mean he had been a “disciple” of Pelicot, Versini-Bullara said. The court will seek to determine how close the contact was and whether the man had sought Pelicot’s advice on how to sedate and abuse his wife.

The investigating magistrates’ summary of the case, seen by Agence France-Presse, alleges the bodyguard had sought to benefit from Pelicot’s “experience” in drugging and raping his wife. The fact that the woman was deeply sedated “ruled out all form of consent”, they wrote.

The man’s partner told investigators she had experienced “great fatigue” over a period of three years without understanding why. She also spoke of heart issues, dizziness and several blackouts.

The bodyguard admitted separate charges of the possession and distribution of child abuse imagery.

payload.title: Ranskalaismies oikeuteen kumppaninsa huumaamisesta ja raiskauksesta Pelicot-yhteyden jälkeen
payload.summary: Lyonista kotoisin oleva henkivartija joutuu oikeuteen epäiltynä pitkäaikaisen kumppaninsa huumaamisesta, raiskaamisesta ja tekojen kuvaamisesta. Tutkinnassa selvitetään hänen yhteyksiään Dominique Pelicotiin, joka tuomittiin vuonna 2024 laajassa raiskausoikeudenkäynnissä.
payload.content:
Lyonista kotoisin oleva henkivartija joutuu oikeuteen Ranskassa epäiltynä siitä, että hän huumasi pitkäaikaisen kumppaninsa, raiskasi hänet ja kuvasi teot. Tapauksen taustalla ovat tutkinnassa löydetyt verkkoyhteydet Dominique Pelicotiin, joka tuomittiin vuonna 2024 vaimonsa huumaamisesta ja raiskaamisesta sekä muiden miesten kutsumisesta hyväksikäyttämään tätä heidän kodissaan Etelä-Ranskassa.

## Syytetty kiistää rikosepäilyt

Mies pidätettiin vuonna 2023. Hänen asianajajansa Gabriel Versini-Bullara on kertonut, että mies kiistää häntä vastaan esitetyt syytteet.

Tutkinnassa on vahvistettu, että syytetyllä oli yhteys Pelicotiin. Asianajajan mukaan tämä ei kuitenkaan tarkoita, että mies olisi ollut Pelicotin ”opetuslapsi”. Oikeuden on määrä arvioida, kuinka läheisestä yhteydenpidosta oli kyse ja oliko mies pyrkinyt saamaan Pelicotilta neuvoja siihen, miten kumppani voitaisiin huumata ja joutua seksuaalisen väkivallan kohteeksi.

Tutkintatuomareiden yhteenvedon mukaan henkivartijan epäillään pyrkineen hyötymään Pelicotin ”kokemuksesta” vaimonsa huumaamisessa ja raiskaamisessa. Yhteenvedossa todetaan myös, että naisen syvä sedaatio sulki pois kaiken suostumuksen mahdollisuuden.

## Pelicotin tapaus varjostaa uutta oikeudenkäyntiä

Dominique Pelicot, 73, istuu 20 vuoden vankeusrangaistusta. Hänet todettiin syylliseksi siihen, että hän murskasi unilääkkeitä ja ahdistuslääkkeitä silloisen vaimonsa Gisèle Pelicotin ruokaan ja juomaan tehdäkseen tämän tajuttomaksi. Pelicot oli yhteydessä miehiin verkkokeskusteluhuoneessa, jonka nimi viittasi tekoihin uhrin tietämättä.

Pelicot ja 50 muuta miestä tuomittiin vuonna 2024 Ranskan historian suurimmaksi kuvatun raiskausoikeudenkäynnin päätteeksi. Gisèle Pelicot sai laajaa kansainvälistä tukea vaadittuaan oikeudenkäynnin järjestämistä julkisena, jotta huumeiden ja sedaation käyttö seksuaalisessa väkivallassa tulisi näkyväksi.

Nyt oikeuteen joutuva mies työskenteli kansainvälisenä henkivartijana korkean profiilin asiakkaille muun muassa elokuvafestivaaleilla sekä matkoilla Yhdysvalloissa ja Persianlahden maissa. Tutkijat löysivät hänen ja Pelicotin välisiä viestejä jo Pelicotia koskeneiden alkuperäisten tutkimusten yhteydessä vuonna 2020.
summary_bullets: Lyonilainen henkivartija on oikeudessa epäiltynä kumppaninsa huumaamisesta, raiskauksesta ja tekojen kuvaamisesta.
Oikeus arvioi, millainen yhteys miehellä oli Dominique Pelicotiin ja oliko hän hakenut tältä neuvoja.
